name: Sanator: Sokrovische Monostruktury
source:
It is always calm right before the storm hits. The times of serenity are always bound to end. A truth that Brother-Sanator Murdock knows like no other. The increase in thefts forces the Brotherhood of Saint Elmo to start its own investigation...

What's hiding in the shadows of centuries, under the dome of a labyrinth that was built in the times of Ailur: treasure or death? Those brave enough to descend into the darkness will either find their answer... or perish.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1644280/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
暴风雨来临前，总是一片平静。安宁的时光终究会结束，这个道理，Sanator修士默多克比谁都清楚。接连增多的盗窃事件，迫使圣埃尔莫兄弟会展开自己的调查……

建于艾卢尔时代的迷宫，其穹顶之下、百年阴影之中，究竟隐藏着宝藏，还是死亡？敢于深入黑暗的人，或能找到答案……或将葬身其中。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1644280/]Steam[/url]]
